brief.zh: 导入保存过的补电函数，让两层循环给整架电池补电。先用小例子找错，修好后再预测新一组的结果。
brief.en: Import your saved charging function and use two loops to charge a whole rack. Start with a small test, then fix the code and predict the result for a new rack.

concept.zh: 复用补电函数，逐排逐块补电
concept.en: Reuse a charging function across rows of batteries

hints.zh: 在「写出电量相加函数」练习里跑通并保存 charge_total。回来选「用我的函数」就能导入。
hints.en: In Write the Charge Total Function, pass the tests and save charge_total. Then choose Use my function to import it here.

hints.zh: 外层的 for row in rows 每次选一排。内层每次取一块，调用 charge_total(charge, added)，把结果放进当前排。
hints.en: The outer loop picks one row. The inner loop takes one battery at a time, calls charge_total(charge, added), and stores the new charge in the current row.

hints.zh: 一排补完就把这一排加入 results。整个电池架处理完，再用 return 交回结果。
hints.en: Save each row in results once that row is charged. Return the results after the whole rack is finished.

label.zh: 每块电池调用补电函数
label.en: Call the charging function for each battery
Return the results after finishing the rack
